_source: reverse/decomp/scripts (MapData.as, StageMapAroundData.as, StageMapBitData.as, MapBossSet.as, WinBoss_PlusNokoriBattleTimes.as, EneData.as, *png.as embed stubs)

_notes.coords: All pixel coords are in map-bitmap space (origin top-left of the full map bitmap). tile = 3x3 streaming grid cell (StageMapDataSet). areaGrid = StageLvMap level grid stretched over the full bitmap. neighbours: up/right/down/left = StageMapAroundData s1..s4 (s1 loads neighbour bottom row => map above, s2 loads left column => map to the right, etc.).
_notes.enemyFields: eneLoad(sprite, scale, hp, atk, expParam, gold, skills, drop1, drop2, drop3, hardDrop1, hardDrop2, hardDrop3). hp/atk are base values (x10 / x8.5 in hard mode, gold x5). exp = OneExpTable(tekiseiLv) * tekiseiLvBai * (1 + expParam/50), or exp = expParam when tekiseiLvBai == -2. For group69_72 / group73_77 pools, hp = baseHP*hpMul, atk = baseATK*atkMul.
_notes.weights: kakuritu(weights): pick index i where cumulative sum >= int(total*random + 0.5).
